UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with personal, career, and core technical credentials.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

email.description: The registered email address of the user.

jobTitle.description: Current target job title (e.g. Frontend Engineer, Registered Nurse, etc.)

industry.description: The industry vertical, e.g. Technology, Healthcare, Creative, etc.

experienceYears.description: Years of professional experience in their career domain.

bio.description: A summary or professional statement about their career and values.

careSpecialties.description: A list of core skills, specialties, or expertise tags.

certifications.description: Active certifications like AWS, PMP, RN, CPA, scrum.

availability.description: Work mode preference (e.g., Full-Time, Remote, Hybrid, Part-Time).

licensedState.description: States or locations in which the user is authorized to practice or reside.

github.description: GitHub profile or personal website URL.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last edit.

users/{userId}.description: User accounts containing personalized career and care portfolios.
